depiction.primary_object: paper scroll or receipt with two lines and curled bottom
modifiers: X mark badge in bottom right corner
depiction.composition: single object with bottom-right overlay badge

readings.meaning: cancel or void invoice, bill, or receipt
dispute or reject a charge on a statement

ambiguity: The curled paper can read as a receipt, an invoice, a contract scroll, or a software script file; at small sizes it looks like a generic delete-file icon.

modifier_semantics.modifier: X mark badge in bottom right corner

cancel a recurring subscription or service

remove an obsolete script or log

reasoning: Shows a curled paper receipt or scroll with an X badge in the corner, clearly communicating cancelling, voiding, or rejecting a bill, invoice, order, subscription, or contract. It fits a common family of financial and administrative tasks, though it can be confused with generic file-deletion icons at small sizes.
